ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: An investigation into the financial trails of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, and how it affects the state's most vulnerable populations.
questions: How much money is being lost to Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
ideas.insight: This story could shed light on the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota, and how it affects the state's budget and vulnerable populations.
